beats.headline: Moonshine, a Krakaren, and a pair of boxers
beats.text: The second floor opens in a French storm shelter with no Bopca and no food, only a suburban mailbox that answers to Donut: she has joined the Dungeon Book of the Floor Club, and her first book is Second Chance, which raises the dead to fight for her. Carl sees a zombie dog army; Donut sees the best spell ever. The floor above collapses behind them with seven hundred thousand people still on it, and a new rule arrives between episodes: relieve yourself outside a bathroom and a rage elemental comes for your whole party. In a quadrant of moonshining clurichauns Carl adds goblin oil to toilet-grade moonshine, corks it with a torch, and the dungeon names the result Carl's Jug O' Boom. Donut talks two fairy managers out of their filling room and Carl burns the forty workers she leaves behind. Then the Krakaren comes out of a door marked Live, Laugh, Love: a tentacled still whose arms are lined with screaming mouths. They drink a blended fairy to survive her, get drunk, and Donut tells Carl she loves him, not as much as Miss Beatrice or Ferdinand, but she does. A zombie carries in the bomb, Carl wraps himself around the cat under a table, and she drags him out by his cloak. The prize is a pair of boxers with little red hearts that cast Protective Shell. Mordecai is a seven-foot Bugaboo now, and a Borant admin in a diving suit gets told that they will not fight on her schedule.

beats.headline: The people train and the Bomb Chicken
beats.text: Meadow Lark has built a train: ten cars of wheelchairs on one glowing chain, pulled by Chris and Imani in pig harnesses. A hundred feet from a safe room, Jack stands up and pees on the wall. Yolanda puts an arrow through his temple a fraction too late, and the level-93 rage elemental that rises out of the stain unravels her and Randall both. Gravity flips. Carl carries Mrs McGibbons along the ceiling under his first Protective Shell, dives through the safe-room door, and goes back out to throw a jug of boom at the thing, which then hammers at the door for hours. Nothing on this floor can kill it, and the rules change so that nobody can sit out the collapse in a safe room. Five hours of work produce the Mother of All Bombs (Brandon calls it the Bomb Chicken), a launcher on a trailer behind the Chopper that drops wheeled bombs Carl calls babies. Imani opens the door, the elemental comes, and with the whole galaxy watching, one man and his ex-girlfriend's cat drag it across an oil slick into the stairwell, where mobs dissolve. Donut Puddle Jumps them clear at the lip. There is no experience, because they did not kill it. They broke the game, and the next announcement patches it.

beats.headline: Pork Boy, a dinosaur, and the way down
beats.text: Thirty-six residents go down the stairs in shopping-cart buckets, and Imani, last of all, gives the ceiling her middle finger. Then a substitute admin overrides Zev and puts the Royal Court on Death Watch Extreme Dungeon Mayhem, where an orc talk-show host called the Maestro makes two crawlers, Li Jun and Zhang, gamble on who lives. Carl works out that he is too expensive to punish, walks the whole group off the show alive (Li Jun, Zhang, their boss and Li Jun's sister Li Na), and calls the host Pork Boy on air. The Maestro takes his revenge with footage: Carl's rat-corpse dynamite went off in Frank and Maggie's party, and Maggie My finished off her own daughter, Yvette. On camera he hands Maggie a Legendary potion of Find Crawler, and she smiles for the first time. He also promises to meet them on the ninth floor, as War Leader of the Skull Clan, where the Blood Sultanate is always first out; Donut admits she heard Mordecai tell Carl to leave her there. In the kobold fighting pits Carl feeds a pet biscuit to every caged dingo, the dingoes turn on their masters, and Ralph the Frenzied Gerbil ends under Carl's bare foot. In the reward room Donut chooses seven inches of furious pink feathers: Mongo, a Mongoliensis, who bites her nose until a hornet grabs him and she takes its head off. He is her Royal Steed now. On Odette's couch they learn what a Mongoliensis is. Carl's people called them velociraptors.
